title: Constrained Spectral Persistence Hypothesis
statement: Across heterogeneous real-world temporal systems, a reproducible non-trivial spectral persistence exponent emerges under deterministic preprocessing and survives adversarial null rejection.

falsification.condition: If alpha exits [0.7,4.5] OR sigma > 0.85 OR cross-domain std > 1.8 OR FFT/Welch disagreement > 0.35
